evidence.claim: The patented genetic processing algorithm that automatically segments 3D seismic volumes into populations of genetically related waveforms called "GeoPopulations".
The Seisnetics Software Suite, which features specialized automated modules including Seis-H for horizon extraction and Seis-F for fault extraction.
A multi-attribute waveform analysis capability that evaluates the entirety of the seismic wavelet using more than 50-plus attributes simultaneously.
Cross-platform structural robustness optimized for both Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 or higher) and Windows operating systems to handle massive volumetric datasets.
A parallelized framework capable of processing single large 3D surveys or analyzing multiple 3D volumes simultaneously.
High-efficiency execution parameters that reduce data extraction times from standard weeks or months down to minutes or hours.
Seisnetics-FZ acts strictly as a software and service developer rather than a seismic contractor, meaning it holds no proprietary commercial multi-client data library.
The software relies entirely on processing third-party client datasets, as shown in commercial field deployments with operators like Tower Resources.
The system automatically generates a comprehensive queryable 3D surface database unique to each processed volume, creating a localized project library of horizons and faults.
Explicit software application design for Time-Lapse (4D) seismic processing, quality control, and automated model building.
Commercial integration with Carbon Guardian and Carbon Seismic to provide AI-supported 4D seismic interpretation for tracking underground CO2 plume movement over time.
Rapid processing throughput that simulates near real-time operational turnarounds, delivering fully interpreted data volumes within a few hours.
A proprietary machine learning framework inspired by the Human Genome Project mapping techniques to sequence chemical base pairs dynamically across structural attributes.
An unsupervised and unbiased deep learning methodology driven by Modified Genetic Algorithms that operates entirely without manual models, training data, or human guidance.
A strategic technical alliance with GeoTomo LLC to deliver fully integrated AI-Driven Reservoir Interpretation Services.

Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) procured Seisnetics software licenses (1 processing and 5 visualization licenses) deployed at their GEOPIC dedicated workstations.
Tower Resources contracted with partners to run Seisnetics AI-driven software on their complex geology exploration assets for rapid evaluation and visualization.
Buru Energy utilized Seisnetics to process the Bunda 3D Seismic Survey in the onshore Canning Basin to map reservoir units and production zones.
Headquartered at a flexi office within the Ras Al Khaimah Economic Zone (RAKEZ), United Arab Emirates.
Maintains international commercial contact channels spanning the Middle East, USA, and Europe (France).
Relies on external regional processing and software distribution networks rather than proprietary centers, such as Total Depth Pty Ltd in Australia and Essem High Tech in India.
Operates as a privately held Free Zone entity (Seisnetics-FZ LLC), with no public financial disclosure of revenue, backlogs, or growth percentages.
Commercial transaction volume is tied directly to variable data scaling, using a non-linear power function pricing model where cost is calculated per gigabyte (GB) of 32-bit seismic data processed.
Strategic distribution and technical alliance with Essem High Tech Pvt Ltd to deliver Seisnetics AI/ML software platforms across the Indian energy sector.
Joint technical and data integration partnership with global geoscience data provider TGS to deploy the Seisnetics AI engine for unsupervised interpretation on the 12,400 km² Santos Sul 3D survey.
Regional service provision alliance with GEO Resources Consultancy Oman to offer Seisnetics AI-driven reservoir characterization within their broader earth sciences portfolio.
Operates as a specialized, niche player with a modest global headcount of 11 to 50 employees.

Software application is designed as a complementary pre-interpretation layer that exports directly to industry-standard market leaders like Schlumberger's Petrel platform rather than replacing full-scale processing suits.
Has established a cumulative deployment baseline encompassing hundreds of 3D seismic surveys globally across multiple play types.
